prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet across 10 tests.
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes lean negative across 3 tests, with one stopped early due to worse adoption.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screen, finish new flow, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests with negative predictions measured positive or near-zero results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -2.3% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, redesign: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Data Protection Note: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing in prevents pet reset issues across sessions. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign_in has a 72.9% completion rate.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Placement and Interaction Hub: Redesigns the final home intro screen into a split layout featuring quick interaction tips and desktop control shortcuts. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with long completion times (395s median), and support reported 3 complaints on unclear pet controls.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Grid Selection: Redesigns the companion selection screen into a compact grid layout with step progress indicator. (why: Adoption step has the biggest drop (60.9% conversion) and long completion times (89s median / 1017s mean).)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time Notification Banner: Enables completion notification and estimated wait time display on the waiting screen with background completion guidance. (why: The waiting step has a 201s median / 2336s mean duration, and support received reports of app stalling.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Compact Overview: Reconfigures the intro story screen to a compact layout to streamline initial path onboarding. (why: The choose_path phase takes a high mean duration (514s), indicating drop-off friction during initial narrative presentation.)
5: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Visibility Verification Step: Inserts a dedicated visibility check screen before home intro to ensure the pet renders properly on user desktops. (why: Support logged 3 issues regarding pets not rendering on desktop or app failing to display after setup.)
6: [choose_path, incentive] Path Choice Instant Setup Tag: Adds an instant setup badge component to the path selection screen to encourage faster path commitment. (why: Choose path has a 76.2% conversion rate and a mean completion time of 514s.)
7: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Centered Stage Layout: Updates adoption certificate display layout to centered mode with explicit progress tracking. (why: Adoption step drops to 60.9% conversion; a cleaner confirmation layout reduces hesitation prior to pet generation.)
8: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Account Stability Messaging: Updates sign in screen headline and body text to emphasize account data protection and pet persistence. (why: 8 support emails complained about lost or reset pets after re-authenticating.)
